stage_summary: The gate-closure branch adds exact-commit product-native CI coverage and a preregistered physical-evidence qualification contract. The retained EP4 whole-phone candidate is still rejected at all three finite poses. EP5 and resumable bearing work are separate research in progress; no gate is promoted from software tests. hardware_summary: Formal collection on 2026-10-20 used the existing Pocket4 ADB service at 127.0.0.1:5061: 17 read-only commands succeeded, transport ID stayed 37, server boot/PID/start identity stayed unchanged, and source/design inputs matched exact f4db100. The imported record retains XT2551-3 only; ten other identity fields remain null, no seven-role physical inventory is supplied, and all 12 physical terminal interfaces remain unbound. ro.boot.hwrev is empty and is not converted into a board revision. Earlier software observations (3430/1140 mAh design values, 4570 mAh sum) and Chinese OEM manual values (4700 typical / 4540 rated mAh) keep their own dates and distinct scope. They do not prove the 4700-mAh layout. Actual board/module labels, dimensions, COF, cells/tabs/swelling, terminal topology, RF/thermal space and modified-phone measurements are still required. See engineering/product-integration-20261018/phase3-20261020/hardware/DONOR_IMPORT.md.
verification_summary: A complete 35-suite attempt on e25cf001 ran 1114 tests: 24 suites passed and 11 failed; source bytes were unchanged and all 1052 materialized Python files parsed. The attempt is not a full pass. Six unavailable original native archives blocked dependent suites; the additional frozen manifest and two BREP files exposed by material-motion have since been restored. The actual runtime was Python 3.12.14, CadQuery 2.7.0, OCP 7.8.1.1.post1, NumPy 2.3.5, SciPy 1.17.0, with no installed Shapely distribution; it was not the locked dependency environment. Offline uv sync --locked could not obtain a missing wheel. New staged native-validation tests (15) and qualification tests (51 new plus 9 legacy) passed, and 23 independent qualification review cases behaved as expected; these targeted checks do not substitute for a new complete run. Configured counts are generated from the manifest. Original EP4 native rejections, physical unknowns and all prior evidence retain their exact source identities.
